bars.says: On an ordinary Webwork map the player sees a buildable jungle without a surface river or permanent pool, with substantial cables through trees, finer local strands and silk carpet identifying spider sites.

meant.intent: Keep the green jungle and the hierarchy of white architecture legible on a natural map; no white-floor replacement, invisible main cables or impassable partition.
meant.source: October 12 owner words quoted in Source/RM_GenStep_WebworkWeb.cs and Defs/ThingDefs_Buildings/RM_WebworkWebNetwork.xml; frozen design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_webwork.md §§1,5,9. Delegated: buildable and hierarchy are the smallest faithful reading, not a coverage quota.

figurative.stands_for: main cables visually stronger than fine strands, recognizable across trunks; no fixed rendered width
figurative.accept: Cables sag between trunks and are easy to pick out even though their drawing is narrower than a literal rope described in the lore.

accept: Trunks and undergrowth remain readable behind spanning silk; carpet marks a nest site and open ground accepts ordinary colony buildings.
A scout can climb over a cable and still distinguish it from the fine sticky threads beside it.
reject: A continuous white floor replaces the jungle, although the biome still spawns trees.
The main silk looks like scattered fence posts and blocks passage across otherwise buildable ground.
A permanent pond is supplied as the jungle water source.
bars.lazy: none: the words require the operative contrast in the pictures; a decorative or forced substitute is expressly excluded by says and the asserted starting state.

bars.says: On a living Webwork map, actual web contact, deliberate cutting, carrying stolen eggs and ship landing give a readable signal that brings available owners together through shaded approaches toward the intruder, with signal-directed pursuit ending when that signal expires.

meant.intent: The web does work: event to signal to ordinary hunter target/job, rather than only applying a hediff or spawning a staged manhunter.

figurative.accept: The hunters respond to a carrier without any faction land claim or territory ownership UI.

accept: A scout steps on a registered strand, is visibly marked with a thrum, and an awake owner changes target and approaches through shaded ground.
An egg hauler remains marked; after dropping the cargo the mark expires and the hunter stops tracking that cause.
A ship on bare landing ground wakes a living nest owner, which approaches or visibly waits at the sunlight boundary.

reject: A touched pawn receives a mark, but ordinary owners continue wandering until a proof method starts their jobs.
An egg in hauling hands escapes detection because only inventory is checked.
A landing emits only an introductory letter.
Reloading or a dead target leaves a permanent, source-free hunt.
Only a nearby manhunter reacts while other available owners ignore the signal or queue indefinitely at the same blocked crossing.
bars.lazy: none: the sentence requires the causal or comparative outcome illustrated; a mark without coordinated pursuit, token loot, or an icon without route protection does not satisfy its words.

sees.on: All retained Webwork and required shared-engine mechanics on at proposed shipped defaults, next-version and retirement candidates off, all DLC loaded, no research/AI lock and no forced weather. Negative controls are separate calibration replays, never the primary reading.
sees.control: A wall, disabled AI or heat system could explain safety. Show an otherwise passable exposed path is refused for the exposure reason, and the same path is taken after genuine shade returns. Compare shared felt-temperature reads at identical geometry on a control biome; ambient air is unchanged. Scald physiology and colonist sun heat use the same exposure geometry, not the same health effect.
sees.reset: Discard the disposable local scenario and restore its initial saved snapshot/settings fingerprint; no canonical world save or tile edit. The whole-run save/reload is part of the reading, not a reset bypass.
sees.live_only_why: Not live-only once M3/M2 are validated: geometry, route admissibility, scald transitions and a work budget can discriminate these contrasts; actual presentation remains in B1/B4/B8.

tests.reject: The frozen play advice makes the clearing the fortress and names its failure modes. A harmless icon with unstoppable crossing is the laziest rejected implementation.
tests.renormalize: No pinned stat, yield, time, size, density quota or variant count; retuning a check does not change the accept/reject categories. A change that reverses the stated player-facing comparison is a behaviour change, not mere renormalization.
tests.first_version: Signature counterplay plus growing land. Ordinary walls/fire/roof tools suffice; no traction lance or rite needed.

bars.says: Across a season on a full Webwork map with all retained mechanics running, the colony can keep a clearing, take treasure and encounter living web predators without the map becoming a predator flood, an emptied jungle, a stalled cycle or an error storm, including saved reload and reordered actions.

meant.intent: Exactly one whole bar: establish the complete living trespass/refuge/extraction cycle rather than independent green test scenes. Full defaults, no locked mechanic/sky, next-version extras off.
meant.source: Delegated from November 16 whole-mod requirement, root jungle-growth sentence, October 20 experience and frozen light-moat play advice. Duration, compression protocol and counterexample categories below are Designer choices, not owner tuning bars.

figurative.stands_for: routine actions sustain accumulating owners until ordinary work cannot use a maintained refuge or routes
figurative.accept: A genuine difficult hunt and a temporary cluster can happen while ordinary maintenance and later extraction remain possible.

figurative.stands_for: the retained land/life no longer regenerates or encounters become impossible through systemic consumption
figurative.accept: A burned worked margin and temporarily scarce prey coexist with living forest and later ecological activity elsewhere.

figurative.stands_for: required contacts, jobs, regrowth or living-nest renewal cease despite their legitimate preconditions
figurative.accept: After deliberate eradication no egg renewal occurs until a live owner returns, rather than fabricating renewal to keep a graph green.

figurative.stands_for: repeated runtime errors or retry loops corrupt or prevent ordinary play
figurative.accept: A clean explicit refusal on an artificial blocked placement is not a retry storm.

figurative.stands_for: valuable local fabric and inert egg cargo that advances the colony, not a scripted chest or quest jackpot
figurative.accept: A raiding party sells perishable eggs through ordinary trade and uses cloth in equipment with no treasure quest.

accept: Maintained colony ground persists, abandoned shade grows back, actual contacts bring hunters, recovered cargo advances a planned colony improvement and a surviving nest later renews eggs; the saved run resumes without duplicates.
The reversed work-and-haul order changes the danger encountered but still supports the same legible refuge and extraction cycle.
reject: A passing showcase freezes weather and disables fire, growth or ordinary AI while staged harvest and predator probes run.
Repeated harvesting keeps adding owners until ordinary maintenance cannot function, or predators erase the living prey and jungle cycle.
Reload duplicates owners, nodes, marks or rewards, resets the nest clock, or leaves jobs retrying without progress.
The party can work only because a later-version lance, siege payout or campaign quest was silently left active.
bars.lazy: none: the words require the operative contrast in the pictures; a decorative or forced substitute is expressly excluded by says and the asserted starting state.

range.varies: Supported landable RM_Webwork local maps, engine-permitted dimensions 200–400 cells per side, flat/hilled/mountainous accessible ground; hot-dry and storm-fed local weather regimes at the authored fixed sun positions; colony 1–40, days 0–100, before/after one or more reloads. Relevant axes are refined below; combinations sharing a failure mechanism are grouped, not omitted. Whole supported local regime: 200–400-cell engine-permitted full maps, accessible flat/hilled/mountainous land, authored hot-dry/storm-fed weather and actual fixed sun positions; settled 4/12/40-pawn schedules plus a foot/ship arrival branch, natural sparse/dense canopy and intact/severed web. Run at least a natural season, extend to 30–60 days or longer until natural egg renewal and no-mother branch are observed; check old established day-100 starting states for accumulated history. Include halfway saved reload, real target death, and paired action orders clear->harvest->haul versus harvest->haul->clear from the same initial state. Replicates cover stochastic variation until stable regime conclusions; exact sample count belongs to M2 calibration/checks. Colony cardinality is swept from 1 through 40 for queue/limiter boundaries in M1/M2. Solo/party, small-camp and established-colony live anchors are grouped only by the same failure modes (acquisition coalescing versus maintenance workload); any detected scheduling threshold becomes a separate representative.
range.left_out: Alternative planets/world generation, DLC-absent play, unsupported off-biome mechanics, deferred extras, colonies above 40 and artificial maps with no legal accessible ground are outside this version. Normal corpse/death/despawn transitions are included, not exempted.

sees.instrument: Actual natural-clock full-map run and observer T41, preceded by calibrated M1/M2/M3/M4 to select worst regimes and cheap counterexamples. Time compression may increase simulation speed or skip rendering only; it preserves game ticks, weather durations, job scheduling, growth/age, fire, hunger, medical and nest deadlines. No direct completion, forced due-time, weather lock or population reset. A generated local map is not a generated world.
sees.start: Naturally created local RM_Webwork map, true shipped retained settings and content fingerprint, all research/access relevant to kept features available, next-version defaults off in base and campaign. Ordinary colony supplies/skills recorded; fixed sun unmodified; world never repainted. Capture complete state at start, midway save, reload and milestones; same recorded actions replayed in second order.
sees.on: All retained Webwork and required shared-engine mechanics on at proposed shipped defaults, next-version and retirement candidates off, all DLC loaded, no research/AI lock and no forced weather. Negative controls are separate calibration replays, never the primary reading.
sees.control: Instrument snapshots might hide temporary flood/stall or forced disabled mechanics. Continuous event/state timeline records effective settings, owner/node/cargo identities and production jobs between checkpoints; M2 predicts worst windows, actual game recorder samples them. A separate no-maintenance branch must regain canopy and show a changing approach, so static refuge is not credited. Read actual runtime log and life/death/exit provenance, not a mock response.
sees.reset: Discard the disposable local scenario and restore its initial saved snapshot/settings fingerprint; no canonical world save or tile edit. The whole-run save/reload is part of the reading, not a reset bypass.
sees.live_only_why: A whole-map model predicts regimes only after calibration and omits live engine coupling/presentation. The complete seasonal result, natural placement, scheduling, saved reload and lived workload still need actual game execution; targeted forced probes cannot substitute.

tests.reject: The November 16 instruction explicitly requires the complete cycle. A set of isolated passing examples that collapses in aggregate is a rejected mod.
tests.renormalize: No pinned stat, yield, time, size, density quota or variant count; retuning a check does not change the accept/reject categories. A change that reverses the stated player-facing comparison is a behaviour change, not mere renormalization.
tests.first_version: Whole land/life/signature. All extras explicitly off, no additional version promise.

checks.what: Floor: actual package load, clean log and superb searchable/resettable persisted settings; all DLC in each supported configuration. Broken check is evidence to repair, not an independent owner bar.

Resolved animalDensity/plantDensity positive, current complete ordinary roster and products/diets/flight fields/graphics resolve, including post-patch campaign entries. No field-count or art-variant bar. Source raw BiomeDef currently has 6 animal keys and 17 plant keys; these are def measurements, not live composed counts.

Existing validation.py, northstar_plan.py, C# proofs, harvest runner and Source/SelfTest kernels retained as regression readers. Record source/settings/runtime fingerprints; prior record proof is stale or missing, no current runtime pass claimed.

Current SenseWeb ScanIntervalTicks=250 and missing RUT_Webwork_FeltMark/RUT_Webwork_Egg soft lookup are measured source facts; require valid current content refs and actor/cargo adapters. Proposed expiry 60000 ticks since refresh; inspect source/expiry/reload state.

Existing egg relay default 20–30 days, clutches 1–2 when existing clutch absent; record Normal ticker and saved nextRelayTick; ordinary egg no hatcher/food/medical recipe and current rot field. Exact quantities remain tuning, no force-due proof of natural period.

Record current cable pathCost 30, strand 14, zero edifice fill, natural node overlap counts, actual legal site fallback coverage and no impassable cable partition. Geometry boundary invariants are model checks.

Record actual shared sun/shade values, threshold predicates and scald severity/capacity stages; no effective heatKind/heatOffsetC/minScaledHeatOffsetC/overheadAboveElevationDegrees override from Webwork. No lamp-as-sun or canopy-cooled ambient air.

Existing emergence base chances cable 0.03, strand 0.01 and configured multiplier; record production destruction mode/actor and finite population result. Check no force-break killedLeavings cloth and no double callback payout/spawn.

Generated stock/reward/material audit records each source, actual resale chance/count/price tier and buyer receipt. Preserve approved rare expensive resale. A source-count/yield/price number is a regression reading only.

Extra gates: actual fresh default map and caller-selection state absent things/jobs/letters/incidents, on-arm eligible presence, clean log; saved cocoon/quest/rigging shutdown preserves pawn/items. Field, Scribe fallback, reset and composed/campaign effective settings match.

Observer records full-map season tick/weather/fire/growth/AI histories, actual midway saved reload and reversed actions; natural relay extends beyond a season if needed, day-100 seeded-history case recorded. These numbers specify observation, not passing experience.

Model calibration exact IDs/events/registration/exposure decisions; aggregate M2 area/work tolerance initially 10%, M3 continuous shade tolerance 0.001 away from boundary; failure at a regime boundary invalidates it. Models are predictions, not measurements of the game.

rules.rule: Use normal local MapCommonBase placement, exhaustive legal-space fallback for nest and accessible clutches, visible cable hierarchy and slow passable crossings; natural nodes do not overwrite inhabitants/buildings or automatically regrow after cutting. No world mutation.

Contact marks the living pawn on registered occupied cells, actual deliberate cut or living-map ship event; eggs in hands/inventory maintain the same map-wide mark. Proposed expiry one day from last contact/refresh, scan initially existing 250 ticks; shelves/corpses/off-map cargo mark no pawn. One acquisition cue; persist expiry/source and reconstruct overlap counts once on load. Clutches register occupied cells and successful mining records the miner contact; nest wall guardian wake remains separate.

Existing awake/dormant map owners answer with acquire/wake then shade-reachable pursuit or visible boundary hold. Prefer configured generic droids among otherwise equivalent reachable prey; route exposure refusal wins. Coalesce triggers, never duplicate a landing per colonist, cancel on death/despawn/expiry. A fully cleared map creates no resurrection; live nest may answer. Initial response-latency check bound one game hour, never a bar. Multiple available owners must converge over usable shaded approaches, not strand a conga line at a blocked cell; no new caste/squad UI or faction alliance. Expiry cancels only signal-directed pursuit; ordinary visible-prey hunting may resume, never pacification.

Use shared geometric shade and solar exposure only; species scald cripples, never downs alone, rises exposed and recovers shaded. Owner voluntary hunting paths refuse exposed crossings; forced exposed owner may retreat. Roofs/parasols shade, lamps do not. Same geometry gives same Direct Sun into vanilla heatstroke, ambient air unaffected. Old Webwork heatKind/offset fields must have no effective role.

Eggs are inert perishable Sellable ordinary cargo, never food/medicine/hatchers. Existing nest guardian is bounded and renewal uses any living local ollathrix, not unique mother identity. Initial ruled relay 20–30 days, existing nearby clutches suppress accumulation, destroyed walls do not regrow, due time persists and no load catch-up shower.

Deliberate player natural-node cuts and ordinary butchery supply thrixweave; clutch mining and finite existing nest-wall salvage supply eggs. Combat, beetle, burn and cleanup yield no fabric and cause no harvest emergence. Real cutting records touch even if the existing separate small emergence roll misses; visible emergence and no duplicate event handling. Do not use siege/giant/specimen rewards as local harvest.

Quarrok autonomously chew reachable live registered chewable nodes, deregister by destroyed identity and grant no cloth. Vennick follow valid silk to real reachable finite clutches, eat finite eggs and wander when no route/food exists. Sivvern flight uses actual Core tracker/state and ordinary diet. No directed herding, circling radar, bespoke prey-gleaning/kill-trail AI or new self-predation engine.

Retained settings default on with truthful immediate/startup/new-map timing. Extras field/Scribe/reset defaults off, labelled Next version, gate composed and campaign callers. All-off keeps terrain/roster and ordinary weather while script jobs/active penalties cease safely; preserve saved occupants and items. Preserve the already waived worker, no new worldgen/cross-biome scope.

Use existing ExplosiveGrowth wet-native Webwork profiles and ruled tree life, no separate irrigation/maturity clock. Ordinary clearing/fire removes canopy; real regrowth changes shared shade, not an eternal clearing flag. Growth does not spontaneously recreate web. No biome-specific growth rates or climate field invented to force a pass.

Keep vanilla Hyperweave identity labelled thrixweave, source restriction and the already approved rare expensive Orbital_Exotic resale; ordinary supported buyers can buy inert eggs. Campaign later stockers, Reckoning, bounty, research and site rewards stay off; no extra material tier or premium broker needed. Successful serious extraction should finance a substantial declared next colony improvement (November 10 owner answer); tune quantities/value through checks, not an owner yield quota.

meetings.why: Land picture, ordinary build access, ecological life, conditional sunlight and growth refer to the same physical ground. R1 does not assign safe flags; R4 changes exposure rather than ambient air; R7 creates no duplicate terrain and R8 does not delete ordinary terrain. Thus neither roof shade nor buildability promises absolute safety. This is a logical scope argument, not measured appearance.

Passable main cables, natural accessible nesting, finite local strands, overlap sensing, beetle deletion, mite routes and rebuilding after load share raster/cell state. Finite random placement and skipped cells can break a useful connected route even when each single placement probe passes. Do not infer connectivity from the drawing.
meetings.model: M3 Web, canopy and refuge geometry sweep

meetings.why: Hush is a sparse ambient mix; the thrum is a source-attributed acquisition event. R2 coalesces refresh and R8 preserves its truthful setting timing, so constant egg carry need not become constant sound. Actual mix is still B2 live-only; a logical meeting is not a claim of measured audio.

Contact, cut, landing, carry, prey preference, death/despawn, pursuit, mite/cut node changes and reload all touch one mark/target state. Current absent RUT bindings and missing consumer make persistence and cancellation unestablished. M1 must walk transfer/death/load interleavings, not merely mark-present checks.

Natural owners plus nest spawning and cut emergence consume the thin prey and workers needed to clear shade. Beetles reduce sensed nodes, mites consume future cargo, weather changes available routes; these agree pairwise yet can amplify a harvest->owners->less work->shade->pursuit loop. M2 must settle it with all retained defaults on.
meetings.model: M2 Whole-map living web over time

meetings.why: Readable clearing, voluntary path refusal, physiological scald, Direct Sun cost, canopy return and weather must use the same cached geometric state. A roof-based scald demonstration proves none of real-canopy path safety, updated geometry or colony work affordability. M3 supplies exact boundary calibration; M2 then tests seasonal coexistence.
meetings.model: M2 Whole-map living web over time

meetings.why: Guaranteed reachable cluster, finite mites, living guardian, no-owner stop and saved relay time meet in the same nest. A nearby independent owner intentionally sustains renewal, but consumed clutches, blocked placement and load-time ordering can stall or multiply supply. M1/M3 distinguish legal absence from broken renewal, M2 measures its frequency only after calibration.

Egg carrier risk, extraction reward, finite consumption, source strip/resale and default-off campaign/giant/siege/lance gates share material transactions. Source-only stock and destruction callbacks can pay twice or bypass danger; force-break killedLeavings is a concrete current risk. M4 attributes actual production events and source classes before M2 uses supply rates.
meetings.model: M4 Material and carrier provenance ledger

meetings.why: Ordinary growing land, initial layout and a maintained clearing interact over time. Shared wet-native membership proves eligibility, not that shade returns at a manageable work cost or survives fire without emptying the map. R9 forbids magical silk regeneration, exposing possible late depletion rather than concealing it. M2 decides whether tuning or a rule needs attack.
meetings.model: M2 Whole-map living web over time

meetings.why: Every kept reading and rule relies on effective defaults while shutdown leaves ordinary terrain/life safely present. Startup, new-map and immediate fields plus campaign re-additions and saved jobs can disagree even with a working checkbox. M1 walks actual gates and loaded-state cancellation; the primary whole reading never uses off-arm probes as proof.
